item.summary: India’s exports grew 16.66% to US$ 568.84 billion during April-October FY 2026-27, with gains across products, services and overseas markets. Export promotion measures, expanding trade partnerships and improved logistics are helping Indian businesses sustain this momentum. item.title: India’s Export Growth in FY 2026-27: Strong Performance, New Milestones
